heroHeadline: Russia Kills 6 in Kyiv and Donetsk Hours After Zelensky-Trump UN Talks on Energy Ceasefire
heroSubtitle: A rare daytime Russian drone barrage hit Kyiv on September 23, killing 2 and injuring 43+, burning the historic Shayba market and striking rail infrastructure and a petrol station, while a Russian glide bomb killed 4 in Oleksandrivka, Donetsk Oblast (7 killed region-wide). The strikes came hours after Zelensky met Trump at the UN General Assembly on September 22, where Zelensky said Ukraine was 'ready for energy ceasefire' in any reciprocal format and discussed licensing Patriot interceptor production in Ukraine; Kremlin spokesperson Peskov said afterward there were 'no prerequisites for moving onto a peaceful negotiating track.' Overnight into September 22, a Russian ballistic missile barrage killed 8 and wounded 37 nationwide, including 4 employees at the Interpipe plant in Dnipro, while Ukraine struck the Bashneft-UNPZ refinery in Ufa and the Kuibyshev refinery in Samara. Russian military losses reached ~1,522,440 since 2022 per the Ukrainian General Staff, an increase of ~1,560 in the latest 24 hours.
